newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian navy seizes 24 foreign fishing boats.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian navy seizes 24 foreign fishing boats.

text.p: The Indonesian navy seized 24 fishing boats from Thailand and Taiwan after they intruded into its eastern territorial waters, Media Indonesia said on Monday.
The newspaper quoted navy Chief of Staff Arief Kushariadi as saying that the navy intercepted the boats last week off the island of Tual, about 4,000 km (2,500 miles) east of Jakarta.
About 300 crew members were taken into custody, Kushariadi was quoted as saying by the newspaper.
The navy had stepped up its operations in the area after 50 Chinese fishing boats were caught last month off the coast of Indonesia's eastern Irian Jaya province, he added.
